notes.title: Pre-alpha Version of the game will be released this weekend
notes.notes:
The Pre-alpha version of the game may contain some errors

There will be one level to play

It will free for all and will be uploaded on indiedb and iam also thinking to release the pre-alpha version on steam as demo 

Don't measure the quality of the game by this Demo. There will be many changes in the final version of the game like the level design, the weapons and many more will be changed

Iam just releasing this pre-alpha version for free so that people can support my development 

I work solo on this project, so i'am to do my best for error free release, plz do bare with me guys
